notes: Coverage checked: nine morphemes in eight units, fourteen targets each placed once.
lipne is fused to *before* under rule 30 and headed on the construct noun, with the rectum keeping its own *honor*.

The one contested unit is the italic *goeth*, taken as the copula the construction hands to the whole fused prepositional predicate under rules 20, 30 and 49 rather than as an `added` lexical verb; the competing reading is named in the unit note, and the chapter reads PRO.15.24 the same way.
